d: India's packed cricket calendar is raising serious questions about player workload, recovery and preparation time. With 43 T20Is scheduled in 2026, Sanju Samson has spoken about the lack of time to practise, while Sunil Gavaskar and bowling coach Morne Morkel have highlighted the physical and mental demands on players. Is India's relentless cricket schedule pushing its players too far? Rupha Ramani speaks about the concerns around international cricket, player fatigue and the cost of a non-stop calendar.
